# CBDB-Desktop: Navigation page language support (Nov 10 2026)

The Navigation page (index.html at the root) now follows the display language: its Chinese text is in traditional or simplified characters, and the Users Guide button opens the guide in the display language. The page stays bilingual in every case (user decision, Nov 9). Files delivered: index.html, cbdb_language.js. Tested in jsdom (below); not yet checked in the running app.

## Decisions (user, Nov 9)

1. **Always bilingual.** English + Chinese on every button, the title and the status line, even when Chinese is the browser's first language. This decision is to make clear that CBDB is a bilingual program. Only the Chinese script varies.
1. **No EN / 繁 / 简 buttons, Display Language label or Help button** on this page for now. A choice saved on any other form (cbdbDisplayLanguage in localStorage) still applies here.
1. **Guide files:** /static/CBDB_UserGuide_ENG.pdf, /static/CBDB_UserGuide_CHN-T.pdf, /static/CBDB_UserGuide_CHN-S.pdf, in the constant USERS_GUIDE_FILES at the top of the page script. The old single file CBDB_UserGuide.pdf is no longer used; rename it to …_ENG.pdf.
1. **Go code untouched.** {{.ChineseInfo}} in the footer is written by the server and does **not** follow the script yet. {{.Version}} and {{.LastUpdate}} are unchanged too.

## cbdb_language.js: new preferredChineseScript()

Returns 'traditional' or 'simplified', never 'english':

1. the saved choice, if it is traditional or simplified (a saved english does not decide the script);
1. otherwise the first Chinese entry **anywhere** in navigator.languages (the logic of the commented-out detectDisplayLanguage()), with the same tag mapping as the current detectDisplayLanguage(): the first Chinese tag naming a script or region decides (Hant, TW, HK, MO → traditional; Hans, CN, SG → simplified); if all Chinese tags are a bare zh, simplified;
1. no Chinese entry: traditional (the page's behaviour before this change).

Step 2 uses the current version's mapping, not the commented-out one's, so the two functions agree whenever Chinese is the top choice: ['zh', 'zh-TW', 'en'] gives traditional labels **and** the traditional guide. detectDisplayLanguage() itself is unchanged. The header comment now mentions the Navigation page.

## index.html

- Every Chinese text has class="zh" and a data-key; applyNavLabels() fills them from NAV_LABELS[preferredChineseScript()] and sets lang="zh-Hant" / "zh-Hans" on each, so the browser picks a matching font. The buttons keep their chn class and layout. The static HTML now holds the traditional labels (shown if the script fails).
- Page title: CBDB Navigation 導航 / CBDB Navigation 导航 (導航 as on the forms' ← 導航 link).
- **Users Guide button** (btnUsersGuide): openUserGuide() chooses the guide from initialDisplayLanguage() (saved choice, else browser detection, so English first → English guide). Same pattern as openHelp() on the Index Address form: a blank tab is opened at once, a HEAD request checks the file, the English guide is used if the file is missing, and the tab closes with a bilingual alert if neither exists. If a pop-up blocker returns no tab, the guide opens in the same tab. The href points to the English guide as a fallback if the script does not run.
- **Status line**: English, two spaces, Chinese (setStatus(key, color)); colours as before.
- cbdb_language.js is loaded before the page script.

| Item | Traditional | Simplified |
|---|---|---|
| Title (h1) | 中國歷代人物傳記資料庫 | 中国历代人物传记资料库 |
| 16 buttons | as the table in the session prompt (範例查詢 / 示例查询, 使用者指南 / 用户指南 are the changes) |  |
| Loading... | 載入中… | 加载中… |
| Desktop Version 1.0 \| Database connected | 桌面版 1.0｜資料庫已連接 | 桌面版 1.0｜数据库已连接 |
| Warning: database not connected | 警告：資料庫未連接 | 警告：数据库未连接 |
| Server running | 伺服器執行中 | 服务器运行中 |
| The Users Guide could not be found. | 找不到使用者指南。 | 找不到用户指南。 |

連接 follows the guide's protected term (连接 → 連接); 已連線 is the more usual Taiwan wording for a live connection if the committee prefers it. 資料庫 stays in the CBDB name in both scripts (official name); the simplified status line uses 数据库.
